dataset.title: MG1655 measured per-site DNA methylation
dataset.replacementDisclosure: Substitute site-resolved K-12 dataset for the original Fang et al. 2012 motif-level census. The original census is retained separately; these are not Fang et al. measurements.

targetReference.methodsEvidence: The base-modification analysis methods identify the FASTA reference as E. coli K12 MG1655 accession NC_000913.2, obtained from Pacific Biosciences.

coordinateEvidence.conversion: start0 = supplied Site - 1; end0 = supplied Site. Source Site identifies the modified adenine on its stated strand, not the start of the four-base motif.
coordinateEvidence.strand: Source + and - retained. Plus calls anchor reference A in GATC; minus calls anchor reference T, whose complementary base is A.
coordinateEvidence.scope: All 38,227 supplied site/strand records checked against their supplied GATC motif on NC_000913.2; zero mismatches. Validation uses provided sites only and generates no calls.
coordinateEvidence.plusAnchor: reference[Site-2:Site+2] == GATC, using zero-based Python slices
coordinateEvidence.minusAnchor: reference[Site-3:Site+1] == GATC, using zero-based Python slices

unit: fraction of molecules with methylation signal (0–1)

layers.label: 0 h baseline methylated fractions
layers.unit: fraction of molecules with methylation signal (0–1)

measurementMeaning.methylatedFraction: Direct published per-site fraction from the raw Frac sheet for each baseline biological replicate separately. No averaging or fraction calculation from counts.
measurementMeaning.coverage: Direct published coverage for the identical Site/Strand/Motif/sample key from Supplementary Data Set 2. Coverage is read support, not fraction or methylated-molecule count.
measurementMeaning.quality: No per-site quality/QV supplied by these selected spreadsheets. Quality remains absent.
measurementMeaning.sourceFractionStatus: reported-fraction for numeric cells; below-fraction-reporting-threshold for source N/A; missing-source-cell only for absent source cells.

missingness.sourceDefinition: Sheet A4 defines N/A as methylation signal below the threshold needed to calculate a fraction.
missingness.numericPolicy: Source N/A stays an empty numeric CSV cell and null in JSON, with reporting-threshold status and literal source value preserved. It is never zero-filled. Reported numeric zero stays zero.
missingness.coveragePolicy: Coverage and fraction reporting status are independent; below-threshold fraction can retain source coverage.
missingness.omittedGenomicPositions: Only author-supplied fraction rows in the selected interval are retained. Positions absent from the fraction table are not added, inferred, or treated as unmethylated. Coverage-only rows are not invented as fraction calls.

selection.policy: All supplied fraction site/strand rows with Site <= 500000 and the three baseline 0h biological replicates; no filtering by value.
selection.sampleScope: 0 h baseline only. No antibiotic-treated samples or engineered-strain measurements included.
selection.sourceRowsRetained: Original Excel row numbers and exact underlying XML cell strings retained in source-records.json.

limits: First 500 kb subset, not complete chromosome coverage.
Only source GATC site/strand calls represented; other modification contexts are not asserted.
Fraction estimates pooled-molecule methylation signal; it is neither a count nor quality.
Below-threshold N/A is not measured zero or a universal unmethylated call.
No measured calls inferred by scanning motifs.
Source-declared NC_000913.2 with supplied anchors is used; NC_000913.3 is not substituted.

rejectedCandidate.reason: Supplied GFF uses custom ecoliK12_mutated reference length 4639560, distinct from NC_000913.2 and NC_000913.3. No alias or coordinate transplantation applied.

confidence: high for source preservation, accession binding and strand-coordinate validation

legacyMotifCensus.meaning: Five motif-level detection totals from Fang et al.2012, retained as an aggregate census. No site positions or methylation calls are inferred from these totals.
